sourceText:
Apple Crumble
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 12:11am

Ingredients




4 cups sliced yellow delicious apples
1 tablespoon lemon juice
1 cup quick cooking rolled oats
 cup flour
1 teaspoon cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/4 cup diet butter, melted
Non-stick cooking spray
2 cups water
Artificial sweetener to taste

Preparation

1 Sprinkle apples with lemon juice. In separate bowl, combine oats, flour, cinnamon, salt and butter. Spray a metal bowl that will fit loosely into pressure cooker with non-stick spray. Place alternate layers of apples and oat mixture into bowl, beginning and ending with apples. Cover bowl firmly with aluminum foil and place on rack in cooker. Add the 2 cups of water. Secure cover, and make sure pressure gauge is in place. 2 Bring cooker to pressure according to instructions with cooker, then time cooker for 20 minutes. Cool cooker at once by placing under running water. Sprinkle with sweetener just before serving. Calories: 171. Protein: 3 grams. Fat: 7 grams. Cholesterol: 0 mg. Sodium: 229 mg.
